# A capturing nested component instantiated in a reactive `for` is reported
# rather than emitted (#202).
#
# The boundary is what the inliner already computes. A *non*-capturing nested
# component in the same position survives as a real component whose state the
# render owns -- `var picked by remember` inside the Compose function, per row.
# A capturing one cannot survive that way, because its body reads a var only
# the owner's instance has, so splicing it hands every row the one cell: it
# builds and then behaves wrong. A reactive `if` is the same shape, with the
# state outliving the unmount instead of being fresh per mount.
#
# A loop over a const is the same position once the nested component declares
# state of its own: it has as many copies, and each needs a cell of its own that
# capture would take away.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out reactive.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a reactive if or for'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out2 reactive_if.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a reactive if or for'

# Same program with the capture removed: allowed. android keeps `row` as a
# composable of its own, with `picked` remembered per row; bubbletea, which
# keeps no state of an instance's own, splices it with a cell per row.
sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out out3a nocapture.sngl
grep 'var picked by remember' out3a/MainScreen.kt
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out3 nocapture.sngl
grep 'picked__inst[0-9]+ +map\[string\]bool' out3/model.go

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out4 static.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a for and declares state of its own'

# The same rule reaches a component nested in a platform override body, which
# is a body like any other (#230). The report is unreachable there until the
# owner link travels in the override's own ir.Body -- without it the program
# does not check at all, and with the link but no report it emits bare names.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out5 reactive_override.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a reactive if or for'

-- reactive.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0
    var items = [1, 2, 3]

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    button(text="grow", @click { items = [1, 2, 3, 4] })

    for var i = items {
        row(n=i)
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

window {
    main
}
-- reactive_if.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0
    var shown = false

    component panel() node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    button(text="toggle", @click { shown = !shown })

    if shown {
        panel()
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

window {
    main
}
-- nocapture.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component outer() node {

        row(n=i)
    }

-- static.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    for var i = [1, 2, 3] {
        row(n=i)
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

window {
    main
}
-- reactive_override.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/bubbletea"

component outer() node {
    text(value="base")
}

component outer[bubbletea.platform] {
    var count = 0
    var items = [1, 2, 3]

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    button(text="grow", @click { items = [1, 2, 3, 4] })

    for var i = items {
        row(n=i)
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

window {
    main
}
